As part of our standard quarterly review cycle, all HR personnel are required to complete the Q3 payroll compliance and direct deposit verification through our internal portal.

Please access the portal immediately to confirm the updated compliance checklist:

[SIMULATED LINK: Access BambooHR Compliance Portal]

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Regards,

Director of People Operations
Aegis Healthcare Staffing
